extracted.name: Layered Pea Salad
extracted.description: This creamy pea salad with green bell pepper, lettuce, Cheddar cheese, and crispy bacon bits is easy to make with canned or frozen green peas.
ingredient_lines: 1 cup creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®)
0.5 cup finely chopped green bell pepper
1 head iceberg lettuce, torn into bite-sized pieces
instruction_lines: Stir salad dressing and sugar in a large salad bowl or 9x13-inch glass baking dish until sugar is dissolved.
Add peas and chopped green pepper and mix lightly to combine. Spread pea mixture evenly across the bottom of the dish.
Spread lettuce in an even layer over pea mixture and top lettuce with a layer of cheese. Sprinkle bacon bits over cheese.
